story.process: i first looked at other websites, organizations. analyzed what they usually have, such as motivation, founding time, what they did, statistics, what they proved and call to action to jion. then i drafted up a rough outline in figma for claude to generate a cohesive design system, resuable parts and I edited and compared different choices. presented to board memebers and my deisgn was the final one out of the three presented from my tech team. then i collaborated with my team and board member feed back for improvements of the currrent design, such as addint interactive sliders and information changes. then i built it out on webflow, learned as i built because i had no idea how it worked. also made a webflow helper for me to learn more detilaed css heirarchy .
story.decisions: i decided that the color should be consistent with the logo. also have a more school elements. like round buttons and text fonts. it should be different from corprate websites or other news letter sytle becuase the target audience is middle/highschool ppl. board memebers mainly also liked my visual language.

scan.oneline: this one we can keep as is as what we currently have
it is a sequencer that consists of four shapes swimming in boids formation which also acts as sequencer.

story.process: i first made a sequencer with p5.js, then decided to make each button of the sequencer float, breaking the spatial arrangement, taking away definite control of the outcome. i also decided to add two lines xy axis so when buttons pass through them they make a sound too. i also added harmony lines and logs for both info and visual effect
story.decisions: i decided to scramble the visual order of sequencer buttons to experiement. it would be more fun to play with. also this means that it is not for standard music making but more like a toy.
story.changed: some liked the level of control some didnt. i decided to add a corresponding sequencer map on the bottom so user would know which one they clicked on. for more information and choices.
story.craft: my first actual vibe coded peice. also i liked how the visuals turned out at last.
